records.advice_text: The affected waters are closed for direct water contact. The emergency closing will remain in effect for one week following a spill, unless the sewage spill is determined to adversely impact a designated bathing beach. In these cases, the emergency closing will remain in effect until water quality results are acceptable.

page.title: *Update 6-9-26* Emergency Closing Issued for Cypress Creek due to a Large Sewage Spill

section.text: The Anne Arundel County Department of Health has issued an emergency closure for Cypress Creek in Severna Park to the headwaters of the Magothy River due to a large sewage spill.
